statement.p: Consider a community where people have between 0 and 7 pets. Let \displaystyle{A} be the event of a person having at least 3 pets and \displaystyle{B} be the event of a person having at most 7 pets. Find each of the following sets. Enter your answer by listing the elements in increasing order, separated by commas. Do not put a comma after the last number. If the set is empty, enter DNE.
